summary: Hetzner's experimental Inference API exposes open-weight LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible REST API (base URL https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1 exposing /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions) and is free of charge while in experimental status — performance and availability are not guaranteed and it is not intended for production. Current models: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (MoE, 35B total / 3B active, vision) and Qwen3.8-27B (dense), both with 262,144-token context and text+image input. Rate limits per API key: 4M input and 100k output tokens per 60 seconds, plus 10 requests per 60 seconds; the /v1/models response is the definitive live model list.
claim_steps: Create a Hetzner account and API token at experiments.hetzner.com (per curator input; docs confirm Bearer-token auth; no card mentioned).
Call https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1 with any OpenAI-compatible SDK or curl using 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
List live models via GET /v1/models — the response is the definitive model list during the experiment.
